subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should `claws export` permit only exact healthy installed state, or should it also support an explicit drifted/partial snapshot mode with lineage and a machine-readable drift report?
rationale: The implementation chooses strict exact-state export, while the review discussion proposes a potentially useful but materially different snapshot contract; choosing that permanent user-facing package behavior requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Adopt exact-state export
options.body: Keep strict rejection for incomplete or drifted installs, document the contract, and require proof of both successful exact export and rejection behavior.

options.title: Add an explicit snapshot mode
options.body: Define a separately named snapshot mode with drift reporting and lineage metadata rather than silently exporting partial state.

options.title: Defer export policy
options.body: Pause this slice until the Claw lifecycle owners define the package/export contract for the stack.

recommendation.title: Adopt exact-state export
recommendation.body: Keep strict rejection for incomplete or drifted installs, document the contract, and require proof of both successful exact export and rejection behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the proposed Claw lifecycle/export implementation and can incorporate the selected contract into the stacked series.
